exposure: maternal height <170 cm and shoe size <40
maternal height ≥170 cm and shoe size ≥40
cohort: Women who delivered a singleton macrosomic newborn (birth weight >4,000 g), either vaginally (N = 762) or by urgent cesarean delivery during labor (N = 109).
finding: Maternal height ≥170 cm and shoe size ≥40 were correlated with successful vaginal delivery in women delivering macrosomic newborns.
mod_finding: This study investigated predictors of successful vaginal delivery in macrosomic newborns, finding that larger shoe size and maternal height correlated with a higher likelihood of vaginal birth.
